title: Sweep: config policy single authority (5 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: Config/policy single-authority prescriptions: state-root identity assertions, gate-stage vocabulary validation, fail-loud on unknown values. Amortised from 5 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.
